name: Google Antigravity CLI
description: Persistent agent turns and model routing through a local signed-in Google Antigravity agy CLI.

cliCommands.name: antigravity
cliCommands.description: Inspect and reset local agy conversation state (list / status / reset)

providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Delegate agent turns to a local signed-in agy CLI

permissionMode.description: How agy may run tools. skip: --dangerously-skip-permissions (auto-approve everything, the only mode that works with no further setup). sandbox: --sandbox (terminal restrictions). settings: neither flag, deferring to permissions.allow in ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json.

exposeOpenClawTools.description: Publish OpenClaw's loopback MCP server into agy's HOME-level ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json for the duration of each run, so agy can call OpenClaw tools. Entries are namespaced under the openclaw__ prefix and removed when the run ends; your own servers are left untouched. Set false to leave agy's MCP config alone.

stream.description: Stream thoughts and text deltas in real-time via stream-json. Alias: `streaming`.

streaming.description: Alias for `stream` — the plugin accepts either. Prefer `stream` in new configs.

userDataDir.description: Custom Antigravity data directory (default: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli). Overridden by ANTIGRAVITY_USER_DATA_DIR.

maxResumeDbBytes.description: Cap on the SQLite size (bytes) of an agy conversation the plugin will --conversation-resume. Above the cap, --conversation <id> is dropped so agy starts a fresh conversation and the catch-up hook re-seeds recent turns. Set to false to disable the guard and always resume regardless of size.

enabled.description: List agy conversations from ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversation_summaries.db in the OpenClaw sidebar's session catalog. Disable to keep the agy provider available without publishing its native session list.

sessionCatalog.label: Native Session Discovery
sessionCatalog.help: Controls whether past agy conversations from ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversation_summaries.db appear in the OpenClaw sidebar. Disabling only hides the catalog — the agy CLI backend, provider and slash command stay available. Changes reload the plugin automatically.

sessionCatalog.enabled.label: Discover agy Conversations
sessionCatalog.enabled.help: List native agy conversations in the sidebar.

maxResumeDbBytes.label: Conversation Resume Cap
maxResumeDbBytes.help: Above this SQLite size, the plugin refuses to --conversation-resume and lets agy start fresh so replayed subagent history doesn't balloon the context window. Set to false to disable.
